study.name: Held-out comparison

arms.NOEXEC: Adage's hooks and card, no approved check
arms.BEST: Adage with the person-approved check (A4: verification ownership plus the orientation card)

pass_rule.text: The one-sided 95% upper bound of Adage's model requests divided by the agent alone's, over the paired blocks, is at most 0.90, and Adage's hidden-test passes are at least the agent alone's minus one. Every applicable G criterion must also hold.

study.frozen: The four tasks were frozen on 2026-10-01 before any development result was read and were never used for tuning. Their prompts carry no work order, no test block and no instruction to run tests.
